biological_replicate: A total of 111 patients diagnosed with melanoma metastasis between 1975 and 2011 were evaluated in the study
experimental_design: correlation of protein expression in melanoma lymph node metastases with patient survival and histopathological features
In order to relate protein expression in lymph node metastatic melanomas to patient survival, we attempted an unsupervised classification based on consensus clustering
factor_value: survival (long, intermediate, short), tumor content (>=15%), BRAF status (wild type, V600E, V600A, V600K)
The cohort included 59% of patients with wild type BRAF status and 36% of patients with V600E mutation in the BRAF gene (4% had V600A or V600K mutation)
